note: Synthetic dealer complaints with event recordings (demo).

complaints.text: Car braked hard on its own under the flyover near Chakan on the Pune-Nashik highway at around 80 km/h. Nothing was in front of us. Very scary, the truck behind had to brake and honked.
Sudden jerk and automatic braking while crossing a bridge expansion joint, approx 70 kmph. No vehicle ahead.
Emergency brake activated for no reason on the expressway near a metal plate on the road. Speed was 65 km/h.
Phantom braking twice this week at night on the Mumbai-Pune Expressway near the toll gantry, about 75 km/h. The car behind nearly hit us.
The car slammed the brakes by itself near the toll plaza queue at about 45 km/h. I was about to brake anyway. The system is too aggressive.
After the automatic emergency stop in slow traffic the car rolled forward on its own and touched the car in front. Pilot fleet vehicle.
